request.style: English, contemporary gospel, soaring male lead vocal, gospel choir, Hammond B3 organ, piano, bass, drums, hand claps, building with Spirit-filled joy, 98 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
On the night before he suffered, in an upper room they sat
With the bread upon the table and their hearts were full of fear
He said, I am going to the Father, but you will not be alone
And he spoke a word of promise for the days when he'd be gone

[Chorus]
I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Advocate
To be with you forever
The Spirit of truth
I will not leave you as orphans; I am coming to you

[Verse]
When the day of Pentecost had come, they were all together in one place
Suddenly a sound came from heaven like a rushing, violent wind
Tongues as of fire appeared to them
They were all filled with the Holy Spirit

[Chorus]
I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Advocate
To be with you forever
The Spirit of truth
I will not leave you as orphans; I am coming to you

[Bridge]
But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit
Whom the Father will send in my name
Will teach you all things
And remind you of everything I have said to you

[Outro]
I will not leave you as orphans
I am coming to you
